name: DemandScience
rationale: B2B lead-generation data broker. Subjects were never customers; the description uses none of the scrape/aggregator vocabulary the rules key on, so it defaults to service.

name: B2BUSABusinesses
rationale: HIBP flags IsSpamList, which routes it to combolist, but it is a B2B contact list with no credentials. The exposure is broker-held contact data, not credential theft.

name: LuminPDF
rationale: PDF management service whose users held accounts. Rule false-positived on the phrase 'publicly exposed' describing the leak, not the collection method.

name: Epik
rationale: Domain registrar and web host; the exposed people were paying customers. Rule false-positived on an incidental 'scrap' in a later sentence.
